topics.name: Testing and Benchmarking
topics.description: How to run tests and benchmark the Alkyl compiler.
steps: To run all tests: execute `./scripts/run_tests.sh --parallel`. This will compile, execute, and verify all test cases in the `test/code/` directory in both `unopt` and `opt` modes.

To benchmark and compare backends: execute `./scripts/compare_bin test/code/examples/mandelbrot.kyl --opt --runs 50`. This script uses `hyperfine` and `valgrind` to compare compilation time, execution time, binary sizes, and cache misses across LLVM, QBE, MLIR, and Cranelift.

topics.name: Function Modifiers (total/partial)
topics.description: How to use totality checking in Alkyl.
steps: Functions are `total` by default, meaning they are guaranteed to terminate.
If a function contains a `while` loop or calls a `partial` function, it is automatically marked as `partial` without causing an error.
You can explicitly mark a function using `total int foo()` or `partial int bar()`.
If you explicitly mark a function as `total`, the compiler will throw an error if it contains a `while` loop or calls a `partial` function.
